title: 上海永康路：全世界咖啡店最多的城市｜Shanghai, the World's Café Capital
description:
全世界咖啡店最多的城市在上海——你猜它有多少家？评论区先猜，再看答案。

全世界咖啡店最多的城市，在中国。上海有一万多家咖啡馆（2026 年初约 10,336 家），比纽约和伦敦加起来还多。而这条永康路，是它的心脏：梧桐树下，一步一家咖啡馆；拉花在杯口打转，窗边坐满了人。老洋房、小马路，可以慢慢喝一整个下午。侬好——今朝也来一杯伐？（上海话：你好，今天也来一杯吗？）

The city with the most cafés on Earth is Shanghai — around 10,336 of them by early 2026, more than New York and London combined. Yongkang Road, in the old French Concession, is its beating heart: under the plane trees, there's a café every few steps. Latte art swirls at the rim, every window seat is taken, and between the old villas and narrow lanes you can drink away a whole slow afternoon. 侬好 (nong ho) — Shanghainese for "hi." Fancy one today?

本片无旁白：以中英双语字幕叙述，配免版税音乐。/ No voiceover — narrated through bilingual subtitles over a royalty-free music bed (no AI narration in this video). 「侬好 / 伐」为上海话，片中已如实标注。
